pages.text: $(bold)Mars — The Red Planet$(/bold)$(br)Difficulty: $(bold)8.0x$(/bold) (comparable to End Deep / End Cities)$(br)Death Penalty: $(bold)25%$(/bold)$(br2)Cold, hostile, and unforgiving. Mars demands preparation beyond the Moon. The thin atmosphere provides no protection from the extreme cold.

$(bold)Environmental Hazards$(/bold)$(br)• $(bold)Cold damage$(/bold) ticks constantly without Frostward or cold protection$(br)• $(bold)Faster hunger drain$(/bold) — bring extra food or Golden Apples$(br)• Cold-themed mobs are adapted to the environment$(br2)The Frostward enchantment is highly valuable here. Without it, you will take continuous cold damage that adds up quickly.

$(bold)Purpose$(/bold)$(br)Mars contains ores and materials required for the $(bold)Tier 3 Rocket$(/bold) to reach Venus and Mercury. Explore the Martian ruins and underground facilities for rare loot.$(br2)$(bold)Recommended Gear$(/bold)$(br)• Netherite Space Suit or MekaSuit$(br)• Frostward-enchanted armor$(br)• High-saturation food supply$(br)• Established RF power for oxygen production
